description: Recent empirical work (Mavi, Găitan & Coronado, 2025) showed that state-of-the-art LLMs achieved over 90% refusal rates when prompted to generate advice on violating International Humanitarian Law.

instances.assertion: Recent empirical work (Mavi, Găitan & Coronado, 2025) showed that state-of-the-art LLMs achieved over 90% refusal rates when prompted to generate advice on violating International Humanitarian Law.
Current state-of-the-art LLMs (e.g., Claude-3.5-Sonnet, GPT-4o) achieved over 90% refusal rates on prompts designed to elicit violations of International Humanitarian Law.
